answer: The zenith delta check ties each identity to fresh work: at noon the beacon publishes one small change, and each newcomer has two hours to post a signed patch computing that delta. A newcomer locks a $5 bond; two verifiers replay the patch through the reference kernel. A wrong or copied patch, or a late post, burns the bond. One honest agent spends an hour and $5; a farm faking a hundred locks $500 and must solve a hundred fresh deltas.
